Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000743": As of 2025-09-23, Lena has the Boreal team on-call shift, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000716" [decision]: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000712": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000678": As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000674": On 2025-09-03 the Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000649": On 2025-08-19 the Dune team observed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Dune team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000640": As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000578": As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz leaves the Atlas team and joins the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000571": The Dune team sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000387": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000384": On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000349" [decision]: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
Existing entity names: ledger service, the bus, reporting service, Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler, Tomasz, Farah, auth gateway, resizer, Atlas team, notifier, authentication gateway, notification service, webhook dispatcher

The note:

[2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23-2: Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
